We’re also working on a new mobile experience for ChatGPT! 

It’s easier to get to your favorite features and discover what you can do in ChatGPT. We’re starting with Pro users who have a dot or are eligible to create one. Your dot gets its own tab, and you can pin Codex, Projects, Images, and more to the tab bar. Some of you will see the new experience by default. 

You can turn it on or off anytime in Settings > New ChatGPT Design. 

Super excited to hear your feedback before we roll it out more widely!

My “is engineering a valuable pursuit” math. 

An outcome-oriented, creative engineer is now a 1000x engineer.

A tabs-vs-spaces-debating, miss-forest-for-trees engineer is now a -10x engineer.

The regular knowledge worker is now a 2x engineer.

This is also backed by the distribution of token consumption we see in both our startups and enterprise base. Engineers and software factories will consume exponentially more tokens.

If there’s a takeaway from Anthropic’s success, it’s that coding is the #1 killer app of AI.

items.title: Guillermo Rauch：𝚟𝚎𝚛𝚌𝚎𝚕 𝚋𝚘𝚊𝚛𝚍 has no heavyweight or opini
items.summary:
𝚟𝚎𝚛𝚌𝚎𝚕 𝚋𝚘𝚊𝚛𝚍 has no heavyweight or opinionated UI. It's infra not product. I love the "headless Slack" for agents analogy, because UI is free now.

You can generate and deploy the ideal "factory interface" for each usecase. A security team will focus on vulnerability counts, SEV classifications, confirmed vs unconfirmed.

I've seen internal factories at Vercel built on Board that are just TUIs. Or mostly managed via a Slack agent, and you just focus on the outcomes and giving feedback to the agents. 

The board is like the Redux state manager of your agents. It's foundational.

items.title: Peter Yang：Gemini 4 Neon is getting rave reviews, s
items.summary:
Gemini 4 Neon is getting rave reviews, so I made a new video comparing it to Opus 5.5, my favorite model for everyday work.

Some takeaways:

1. Opus is still better at 3D and design from my testing, but Neon is on par or better at writing and personality, which is a huge accomplishment.

2. @Google Gemini 4 has 3 models, but in reality I think I'll use Neon for 99% of tasks. It's much faster than Carbon and its results are just as good.

3. The $100/mo Gemini Ultra subscription is a steal. You get Gemini 4, YouTube Premium Family (my favorite subscription ever) for ad-free YouTube and Music, 20 TB of storage for all your photos and files, and more.

📌 Watch me test Neon vs Opus across 5 use cases here: https://t.co/irRiNDdqgY

items.title: Aditya Agarwal：Congratulations to the folks at Anthropi
items.summary:
Congratulations to the folks at Anthropic.

SPC's goal isn't just to get people to start companies. 

Today is a good day to explain why.

Two of the people who helped build Anthropic spent significant time at @spc.

@nottombrown showed up at SPC in 2016 with no ML background. He spent his days working through papers with other members, then co-founded Anthropic.

@trq212 joined SPC having just wound down his gaming company. He was working on interpretability when a fellow member asked if he'd tried Claude Code. Soon he was helping build a tool most of us use every day. 

If you put ambitious people next to each other, it leads to extraordinary things.

Sometimes the impact comes years later.

I'm so happy for Tom, for Thariq, and for all of my friends at @AnthropicAI.

items.title: Nikunj Kothari：As these network attacks and impersonati
items.summary:
As these network attacks and impersonation attempts happen, who's securing the elderly? 

Especially thinking about my parents and grandparents.

There are four layers I can think through where this could work.

One is at the browser level, where somebody builds a secure browser that ensures that whatever websites they're going to are secured. Texts typically lead to a link, even for payments. This is why browser is key.

Two could be at the network layer, where there is a physical device, similar to Pi-hole, or an Onavo-like VPN on your phone, that blocks websites that could be deemed unsafe.

Three could be at the payments layer, where transactions that look like scams get flagged before the money leaves.

And fourth and most crazy could be at the phone level, where everything is monitored, and you're only getting calls from your loved ones. Cloned voices would work with a provider like Reality Defender. 

There are individual solutions for this today but none neatly packaged. 

This could all be packaged with insurance that covers any activities on the OS or phone. In that way, incentives are aligned to keep this on the edge.

The buyer would be the kids, someone like me, who get alerted when something looks off.
